svg.title: Language distribution across Osama Anwar's public repositories
svg.desc: Two bar charts from GitHub Linguist data. By volume: Python 93.02 percent, HTML 4.72 percent, CSS 1.29 percent, JavaScript 0.82 percent, Inno Setup 0.16 percent. By breadth, counting repositories where the language leads: Python 11, HTML 9, JavaScript 6, CSS 2. Volume is skewed by two large repositories and no skill level is implied.
